cases.text: Starter costs $12 per user each month. Pro costs $29. Annual billing includes two free months.
You can request a refund within 14 days of your initial subscription purchase. Cancel from Billing settings.
The Community plan is free for up to three projects. Upgrade to Team for unlimited projects at $49 per month.
Enterprise invoices are payable within thirty days. Taxes are added according to your billing address.
POST /v1/events accepts an event name and payload. Supply the Authorization header with each request. A successful call returns 201 Created.
Install the client package using your package manager, import Client, and pass your endpoint to the constructor. Run the quickstart example.
Verify each webhook signature with HMAC-SHA256. Retry deliveries use exponential backoff. The delivery ID is stable across retries.
To migrate version 2 integrations, rename projectKey to projectId. The new client requires an explicit timeout in milliseconds.
Need help? Email support@example.test or open a ticket from your account. Our support desk is staffed Monday through Friday.
If your workspace is unavailable, include the incident time and request ID in a support ticket. On-call assistance is available for critical incidents.
Talk to our help team using the chat button. Typical response time is under two hours during business hours.
Locked out of your account? Contact the recovery team using the recovery form. A support specialist will help verify account ownership.
Our team was founded in 2019 by three engineers. We are a remote company with colleagues in twelve countries.
Join our team. We are hiring a product designer and a software engineer. View our open roles and employee benefits.
Our mission is to make scientific collaboration accessible to everyone. Meet the team building our platform.
Company news: we have opened a new research office in Toronto. Our founder will present the next company update on Tuesday.
Tomorrow will be cloudy with scattered showers. Temperatures will range from 12 to 19 degrees Celsius.
Welcome. Choose an option to continue.
